groups.evidence: Attempt 1 returned an extra function instead of running the invocation body; real output was undefined and callback calls were unmodeled.
Attempt 2 abstained about count++. There was no direct numeric-addition operation. A manual private-array-length program already passes, so the claim that no equivalent composition exists was false.
groups.resolution: Add primitive-only number_add, with strict format, signed-zero/NaN/infinity behavior and coercion rejection tests; do not supply the manual React program to the model.

checks_before_resumption: Primitive number combinations match host Number addition.
Object, proxy, function, string, bigint, nullish and boolean operands reject without coercion.
Actual callback counter accepts correct increments and rejects zero, doubled and negative increments.
All regressions and frozen real-library acceptance gates must pass.
paid_policy: Stop after failed batch; resume only this frozen case after local checks. Preserve failures, prior proposals, scope and actual installed source.

follow_up.contributing_diagnostics: Repeated unbound_local errors omitted variable and lexical location. Synthetic traversal checks also omitted bounded input/branch diagnostics already available in the host.
follow_up.fix: Report at most sixteen lexical diagnostics from proposed code; enable synthetic-only counterexample descriptions. No checker assertions or frozen inputs changed.

model_ablation.evidence: The last mini proposal duplicates object checks, attempts array iteration on primitive undefined/boolean/string/number values, and treats top-level null as a callback. These contradict the provided installed source and frozen scope. Reproduced locally; the unexposed manual program passes the same checks.
model_ablation.decision: One targeted gpt-5.4 repair batch of at most three attempts using the unchanged failing proposal, source and checker. No further mini retries; no interpreter change is justified by these wrong branches.

array_and_scope_follow_up.evidence: Stronger model requested explicit Array.isArray rather than guessing from length. Existing every rejects nonarrays but does not expose its brand predicate for branches. Add is_array with real cross-realm, fake length, coercion-free and revoked-proxy tests.
array_and_scope_follow_up.scope_clarification: The synthetic cases already contained function children, but the old scope did not list them explicitly. New frozen extension 8 names the actual input types and removes expected-output hints; no stimuli were added or removed.
array_and_scope_follow_up.observer_bug: Known callback aliases could change real identity comparisons before replay. Preflight now preserves the original call and emits an explicit identity-observer frontier. Production useDebugValue retains the existing same-function case as a required frontier rather than an agreement claim.

domain_feedback_fix.contributing_checker_defect: The final proposed rule passes normal traversal observations but accepts key-getter and coercion domains. Those independent rejection details were not included in the repair failure list; only a generic status reached the model.
domain_feedback_fix.resolution: Return each failed domain kind and actual observed effect count as bounded counterexample facts. Keep different kinds during feedback deduplication. Original library behavior, stimuli and rejection requirements are unchanged.
